findings.issue: Mobile homepage menu remained open after an outside click or keyboard focus departure.
findings.fix: Dismiss on outside pointer/focus and Escape.

findings.issue: Mobile menu open state survived a resize through desktop.
findings.fix: Reset state at the matching navigation breakpoint.

findings.issue: Skip link left focus on the body.
findings.fix: Make the main content target programmatically focusable.

findings.issue: The preview overflowed internally by up to 29px at 320px, concealed by outer overflow clipping.
findings.fix: Fit metric content and footer within small-phone preview widths.

findings.issue: Several small text labels had insufficient contrast on their backgrounds.
findings.fix: Darken the affected muted text colors. Opaque foreground/background DOM samples rechecked.

findings.issue: Homepage logo clicks did not reliably return to top; mobile registration could open scrolled down (observed scrollY 319 and heading above viewport).
findings.fix: Reset scroll on pathname changes and same-page homepage logo clicks.

findings.issue: Switching dashboard views retained scroll from long content.
findings.fix: Reset scroll on active-view change in the shared shell.

findings.issue: Hospital encrypted document status presentation differed from patient/doctor overviews.
findings.fix: Use the same label and semantic green color.

findings.issue: Shared overview AI input/send controls lacked accessible labels and exposed an implementation term.
findings.fix: Label both controls and use Your records for the badge.

scope: Homepage links and controls are tested against the actual public site without account creation. Dashboard visual/interaction comparisons use populated API fixtures; these do not establish production authentication or permissions. Twenty separate real local API/PostgreSQL/MinIO/Ollama workflow groups passed. Current findings are fixed and deployed; these checks do not establish that every possible state or browser is bug-free.
